label: 🆕 Add column
description: Add a new column with a typed default value. The column can be placed at the start or end of the schema, or before/after a chosen reference column. Leave the default blank to seed every row with NULL.

defaultValue.label: Default value (blank for NULL)
defaultValue.help: Cast to the chosen type at runtime. For dates use 'YYYY-MM-DD'; for booleans use 'true' / 'false'.

reference.label: Reference column
reference.help: Only used when Position = before / after — ignored otherwise.
